Paiṭhīnasismṛti

b; by Halāyudha in Brāhmaṇasarvasva; by Hemādri; in Madanapārijāta an. by Viśvarūpa in C. Bālakrīḍā on Yājñavalkyasmṛti; by Vijñāneśvara in C. Mitākṣarā on Yājñavalkyasmṛti; in Smṛticandrikā; by Aparārka in C. on Yājñavalkyasmṛti an. Haradatta (See Kane, HDS. I. p. 584b).
The texts q. are sūtras, prose passages an. verses.
